theme: CS5 impl audit: block-local let is scoped in the checker
text: CHECKER (checker.rs, all engines): a let inside an if/else, while/while let body or match-arm block no longer leaks into the enclosing scope in the checker; the outer local keeps its type after the block, as the interpreter scopes it. Accepts only: false E0405 (and false E0304 on an exhaustive match) on a rebinding inside a block go away; all 717 tracked files check byte-identical.
